title: Your 100 Mbps internet tops out at 12.5 MB/s #Shorts

yt.title: Your 100 Mbps internet tops out at 12.5 MB/s #Shorts
yt.description:
Network speeds are sold in megabits per second; downloads show megabytes. 8 bits = 1 byte.
Narration is AI-generated.

scenes.text: Your 100 Mbps internet is not 100 MB/s
scenes.narration: Your hundred megabit internet will never download at a hundred megabytes.

scenes.label: GUESS
scenes.q: You pay for 100 Mbps. Max download speed?
scenes.narration: You pay for a hundred megabits. What is the max download speed?
One byte is eight bits. Divide a hundred by eight: twelve point five megabytes per second. So one gigabyte takes {c_gb_s_say} seconds.

scenes.text: Small b = bits. Big B = bytes.
scenes.narration: Small b means bits. Big B means bytes. Ads use the small one.
Check it on your next download.
